text_block_list.text:
Despite not feeling her best, Super
Creek
achieves a great result. However...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Pant, huff, wheeze...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
I'm fine, really... So please... There's no
need to
look so worried... okay?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
It's nothing... But I'm... a bad Creek... for
making...
you worry.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: Urk!
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик
choice_data_list: We're going to get you checked out!

text_block_list.text:
After her emergency checkup, Super
Creek is
prescribed bed rest.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: After sleeping for a while...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Um, sorry for causing you so much
trouble...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Yeah. As long as I rest up, I should be
fine. But...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
I feel like there's this strange heaviness
inside my
body.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
I looked into it but was unable to
pinpoint the
cause.
text_block_list.name: Doctor

text_block_list.text:
You don't know what's wrong? What
does that
mean?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
She has a light case of bad circulation,
and it's
likely to reoccur.
text_block_list.name: Doctor

text_block_list.text: It's hard to pinpoint the cause, however.
text_block_list.name: Doctor

text_block_list.text:
There's still so much we don't know
about
Umamusume physiology, and
there aren't many
case studies for us to
use as reference.
text_block_list.name: Doctor

text_block_list.text: Goodness...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик
choice_data_list: Is there anything we can do, Doctor?

text_block_list.text:
For now, just make sure not to push her
too hard.
Without knowing the cause of
her ailment, I'm
afraid we can't come up
with a treatment plan.
text_block_list.name: Doctor

text_block_list.text:
Tracking down the cause... is your job,
Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Doctor

text_block_list.text:
Yes. Since you're the one who observes
her on a
daily basis, it's up to you to
discern the cause of
her condition and
attempt to neutralize it.
text_block_list.name: Doctor

text_block_list.text:
You'll also need to pay extra careful
attention to
her race schedule for the
time being.
text_block_list.name: Doctor

text_block_list.text: For the time being?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Yes. To give you a rough estimate, I'd
say...
text_block_list.name: Doctor

text_block_list.text: About half a year—until the fall.
text_block_list.name: Doctor

text_block_list.text: Fall? No way... What about the Classics?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't say it's out of the question,
but
common sense would dictate that it's
in your best
interest to forgo them.
text_block_list.name: Doctor

text_block_list.text:
I decide to let Супер Крик rest in the
infirmary
and make my way home.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
As I'm leaving, I suddenly sense a
presence in the
courtyard. I turn to
look...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Sob... You only get one chance... I wanted to win the Satsuki Sho and the Derby for you...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: Three... I promised to win all three... Sniffle...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: Waaahhh!
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
She bursts into tears, bawling like a
child. It
breaks my heart to know that
there's little I can
do to comfort her...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Given the current situation, we shift our
next goal
to the Kikuka Sho. Will I be
able to... determine
the cause of her
condition?
text_block_list.name: Монолог
